test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward score loss
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions, transitions, and FAL graphs and computing forward score loss
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path by composing emissions and transitions graphs and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear graph from an emissions vector with optional log-probability conversion using gtn.linear_graph
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target sequence and blank label using gtn.Graph with nodes and arcs
